15675335868582.title: Malikzadi
15675335868582.description:
A vision of blush and silver, woven for the bride who dreams in heritage. Every inch is adorned with pure kamdani mukaish work, layered with phulkari and kaantha techniques, zari dabka, naqshi, and aari - a masterful symphony of handcraft. Delicate resham threads bloom in soft, multi-toned hues, while purely handmade dabka, naqshi, and zardozi lend an air of regal opulence. The bodice shimmers with intricately embellished florals, finished in a graceful pearl and beaded fringe, cascading into a majestically flared lehenga scattered with silver motifs and a richly worked hemline. The dupatta, framed on all four sides with ornate borders, drapes like a veil of moonlight. A timeless heirloom of traditional artistry - sophisticated, romantic, and destined for the bride who wears splendour like a second skin.

15733060567206.title: Pariwash
15733060567206.description:
A whisper of serenity in cool, luminous ice, gilded in silver like frost upon a Mughal garden in bloom. The floor-length net shirt flows in graceful, ethereal majesty, its entire length embroidered with a delicate linear floral jaal - an intricate lattice of trailing vines and blossoms rendered entirely in pure silver dabka, mukaish, naqshi, and pitta work that shimmers like moonlight caught in dew, each motif more exquisite than the last. The hem and cuffs are finished with finely detailed borders, lending a regal, ornate frame to the ethereal design - precise, poetic, and worthy of a court artisan's finest hour. The self-jamawar trousers follow in quiet, textured elegance, adorned with a beautifully embellished border and a delicate scattered spray along the bottom, grounding the ensemble in rich heritage. Completing the vision, the pure medium silk dupatta drapes like a veil of misty silver - framed by an ornate four-sided border and dusted with a graceful spray across its centre, falling with the languid grace of a queen's mantle. A masterpiece of Mughal heritage artistry, luminous and timeless - made for the woman who wears understated grandeur like a crown of silver blossoms.
